description: Helper class providing static utility methods for mapping between domain entities and DTOs, and handling BigDecimal operations such as scaling and positivity checks. It also includes methods for applying non-null updates to entities.

classes.name: BankingServiceHelper
classes.description: Utility class encapsulating static methods for entity-DTO conversions and BigDecimal operations.

methods.name: toCustomerEntity
methods.description: Transforms CustomerDetails DTO to Customer entity, including nested address and contact transformations.

methods.name: toCustomerDetails
methods.description: Transforms Customer entity to CustomerDetails DTO, including nested address and contact transformations.

methods.name: toAddressEntity
methods.description: Converts AddressDetails DTO to Address entity.

methods.name: toAddressDetails
methods.description: Converts Address entity to AddressDetails DTO.

methods.name: toContactEntity
methods.description: Converts ContactDetails DTO to Contact entity.

methods.name: toContactDetails
methods.description: Converts Contact entity to ContactDetails DTO.

methods.name: toAccountEntity
methods.description: Creates an Account entity from AccountInformation DTO and BankInfo.

methods.name: toAccountInformation
methods.description: Creates an AccountInformation DTO from an Account entity, including bank info details.

methods.name: toBankInfoEntity
methods.description: Converts BankInformation DTO to BankInfo entity.

methods.name: toBankInformation
methods.description: Converts BankInfo entity to BankInformation DTO.

methods.name: toTransactionDetails
methods.description: Transforms Transaction entity to TransactionDetails DTO, including scaling amount and extracting account ID.

methods.name: scaled
methods.description: Returns a BigDecimal scaled to 2 decimal places using HALF_UP rounding, for monetary values.

methods.name: isPositive
methods.description: Checks if a BigDecimal value is greater than zero.

methods.name: applyNonNullCustomerUpdates
methods.description: Updates a Customer entity with non-null fields from CustomerDetails DTO.

methods.name: applyNonNullAccountUpdates
methods.description: Updates an Account entity with non-null fields from AccountInformation DTO, and associates bank info.
